question: country
description: In which country is the company based? Asked through AIGenerator.classify_company_country, only when neither the address nor the company's own page shows the country; an Italian answer gets the Italian email. Every company, person, address and domain here is invented, and every domain ends in .example. The page texts read like what a scraper takes from a company's site; none shows Italy by the product's own rules (VAT number, S.p.A., S.r.l.s., two weak signs), so each one reaches the AI. Some no-evidence pages name places that are not the company's home (where an ingredient grows, where it delivers), so that naming a place is not by itself the answer. Hard cases are those where a careful reader could defend another answer.
